fr.sorbonne_u.components.helpers

Class TracerWindow

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.awt.event.WindowAdapter
      • fr.sorbonne_u.components.helpers.TracerWindow
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TracerI, java.awt.event.WindowFocusListener, java.awt.event.WindowListener, java.awt.event.WindowStateListener, java.util.EventListener

    public class TracerWindow
extends java.awt.event.WindowAdapter
implements java.awt.event.WindowListener, TracerI
    The class TracerWindow implements a simple tracer for BCM printing trace messages in a window.

    Description

    Trace windows are managed as Java AWT windows. In this toolkit, the position, width and height of a window are set in screen pixels unit having a (0, 0) origin in screen units at the top left of the screen. When creating an instance of TracerWindow, its position can be set in screen pixels units.

    To facilitate even more the positioning of trace windows, this class also allows its user to use a tiling coordinates system. In this system, the screen is divided into a number of tiles in width and height and the windows are positioned in X (width) and Y (height) using zero-based tile coordinates rather than the screen pixels unit. The number of tiles in width and height is set by default at 5 in both directions, but this can be changed using the static method setTilingSize.

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       screenWidth > 0
 invariant       screenHeight > 0
 invariant       frameWidth > 0
 invariant       frameHeight > 0
 invariant       TILING_WIDTH > 0
 invariant       TILING_HEIGHT > 0
 invariant       BANNER_HEIGHT >= 0
 invariant       !useTilingCoordinates || xTilingRelativePos >= 0 && xTilingRelativePos < TILING_WIDTH
 invariant       !useTilingCoordinates || yTilingRelativePos >= 0 && yTilingRelativePos < TILING_HEIGHT
 invariant       xScreenPos >= 0 && xScreenPos < frameWidth - xOrigin
 invariant       yScreenPos >= 0 && yScreenPos < frameHeight - yOrigin

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

      • TracerWindow

        public TracerWindow(java.lang.String title,
                    int frameWidth,
                    int frameHeight,
                    int xScreenPos,
                    int yScreenPos)
        create a tracer at the (xScreenPos, yScreenPos) position in the screen coordinates having a width of frameWidth and height frameHeight.

        Contract

         pre     frameWidth > 0 && frameWidth < getScreenWidth()
 pre     frameHeight > 0 && frameHeight < getScreenHeight()
 pre     xScreenPos >= 0 && xScreenPos < getScreenWidth()
 pre     yScreenPos >= 0 && yScreenPos < getScreenHeight()
 post    !this.isTracing()
 post    !this.isSuspended()
        Parameters:
        title - title to put on the frame.
        frameWidth - width of the tracer frame.
        frameHeight - height of the tracer frame.
        xScreenPos - x position of the frame in screen pixels unit.
        yScreenPos - y position of the frame in screen pixels unit.
